title: Co-Leaseholder Step on Zero-Deposit Guarantee Coverage: Security Deposit Account
content:
**Q. How do co-leaseholders affect the guarantee coverage of a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan Security Deposit Account?**
A. Co-leaseholders add a step to the coverage multiple. The step depends on how many adults signed the Apartment Home Lease:

- **0.25** when three or more adults signed the lease;
- **0.10** when exactly two did;
- **no step** when one did.

**Q. How is the step used?**
A. The step is added to the coverage multiple. The multiple plus the step is then applied to the coverage rent.

**Q. Which record decides it?**
A. The number of adult applicants who signed the Apartment Home Lease.

### Ladder

| Adults who signed the lease | Step added to the coverage multiple |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.25 |
| 2 | 0.10 |
| 1 | none |

### Hypothetical figures (coverage multiple 1.50, coverage rent 2000.00 USD)

| Adults | Multiple with step | Multiple with step times the coverage rent |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1.75 | 3500.00 |
| 2 | 1.60 | 3200.00 |
| 1 | 1.50 | 3000.00 |
